name: Aimtron Electronics Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2011, Aimtron Electronics Ltd  is in the business of manufacturing Printed 
 Circuit Boards (PCB) and also also provides services related to the designing of PCBs[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AIL specializes in Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM), focusing on high-value precision engineering and complex product manufacturing. With expertise in embedded design, it has completed 250 projects for over 500 global customers.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 29.4%
cons: Stock is trading at 10.3 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 199 days.
